verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client for the GitHub.com platform, used for triaging, reviewing PRs, and managing Copilot tasks. Connecting directly to a user's own servers without a relay, proxy, or VPN is a remote-access and networking axis outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships direct server connectivity.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect directly to my servers without relying on a cloud relay, proxy, or VPN
